authority_notes: Provider-neutral observed identity/run/usage projections plus pure Agent lineage, revision catalog and authority-verification contracts. The catalog keeps candidate and unverified approval_claim events inactive. Only a separately supplied trusted pin that exactly binds the claim, Owner/authority/verifier, project scope, Family/Mark/Deployment/Memory digests, validity and revocation epoch can produce a verified active-binding receipt. The verifier still performs no catalog mutation, persistence, runtime/task call, approval/promotion or external/clock read. Actual durable writer and deployment remain separate gates.
